checks.name: monodromy
checks.scope: All orders, inverses, contragredients and cusp relation.

checks.name: cusp invariant lattices
checks.scope: Primitive full kernels in exterior degrees 1,2,3; ranks 1,2,4,2,1.

checks.name: global invariant/coinvariant lattices
checks.scope: All exterior degrees; printed B2/B3 entrywise; no hidden torsion.

checks.name: finite invariant and pullback arithmetic
checks.scope: All fixed powers, saturated bases, norm lattice, Gram determinants, degree-three perfect-pairing coefficients.

checks.name: fixed/moving product-cover lattices
checks.scope: Full images and kernels, primitive summands, and exact indices 3 and 2.

checks.name: period cocycles and deck normalization
checks.scope: Cyclic affine identities, exact cusp shift, full period covariance, and parabolic trace equation.

checks.name: central complex product maps
checks.scope: Unchanged original periods, moving eigenlines, product linear maps and complete kernel points.

checks.name: terminal certificates
checks.scope: Primitive degree-two image, displayed minors and terminal group determinant.

limits: Exact arithmetic only. Analytic construction, toric properness, finite covering and normalization arguments were independently read and rederived in the separate full-proof ledger.
